bounds.name: thm:main_hetero_k2
bounds.description: k=2 heterogeneous diagonal cost: ||d|| >= sqrt((a1^2+a2^2+2*rho*a1*a2)/(1-rho^2)), a_i = tau_i/m_i.

bounds.name: cor:k_uniform
bounds.description: Uniform-conflict k-bound: ||d|| >= (tau/m)*sqrt(k/(1-rho(k-1))) for k in {2,3,4,5,8}, rho < 1/(k-1).

bounds.name: thm:gram_hetero_postfix
bounds.description: Heterogeneous-m k-Gram bound (post-fix): ||d|| >= sqrt(alpha^T Gamma^-1 alpha), alpha_i = tau_i/m_i. This is the form that survives PAT's critique.

bounds.name: thm:gram_ORIGINAL_buggy_demo
bounds.paper_location: paper/main.tex:319-325 (PAT's critique of the m=min substitution)
bounds.description: PAT's original critique: substituting m=min_i m_i into the uniform-m formula is NOT a valid lower bound under heterogeneous magnitudes. This entry passes ONLY if counter-examples are found (gate inverted). Permanent demonstration in the cert that we know why the post-fix form is necessary.

bounds.name: app:preservation_general_k
bounds.description: Preservation-constrained min-norm: ||Delta_preserve|| = (tau/m)/sqrt(1 - h^T G_P^-1 h). Random PD Gram, p prior unit vectors with active preservation halfspaces (<u_i,d>=0) plus active constraint <u_j,d> <= -tau/m.

bounds.name: prop:staging_reduces
bounds.description: Stage-p step magnitude under uniform conflict: (tau/m)*sqrt((1-rho(p-1))/((1+rho)(1-rho*p))) for p in {1,..,4}, rho*p<1.

bounds.name: cor:k_uniform_ADVERSARIAL_near_cliff
bounds.description: Adversarial: cor:k_uniform with rho within 1e-9 to 1e-3 of 1/(k-1). Tests whether the bound holds at the rank-deficiency boundary (where lambda_min(Gamma) -> 0 and the bound diverges).

bounds.name: app:preservation_ADVERSARIAL_near_singular
bounds.description: Adversarial: preservation bound with rho*p within 1e-6 to 1e-2 of 1. 1 - h^T G_P^-1 h shrinks to ~eps; verifies the divergence rate of (tau/m)/sqrt(1 - h^T G_P^-1 h) matches the numerical min-norm.

bounds.name: prop:staging_reduces_ADVERSARIAL
bounds.description: Adversarial: staging bound with rho*p within 1e-6 to 1e-2 of 1. Verifies delta_staged^(p) blows up at the predicted rate.

bounds.name: cor:uniform_k2_explicit
bounds.description: Explicit k=2 uniform corollary: ||Delta|| >= (tau/m)*sqrt(2)/sqrt(1-rho). Verifies this is consistent with cor:k_uniform at k=2.

bounds.name: cor:active_set
bounds.description: Active-set restriction: ||d^*||^2 = tau_A^T Gamma_A^-1 tau_A. Verified by adding orthogonal inactive constraints with tiny tau and checking the bound equals the active-only bound (plus a negligible orthogonal contribution).

bounds.name: prop:gram_spectrum
bounds.description: Gram spectrum: lambda_min(Gamma) = 1 - rho(k-1) for uniform conflict. Verified by comparing np.linalg.eigvalsh(Gamma) to the closed form and using lambda_min in the cost bound (tau/m)*sqrt(k/lambda_min).

bounds.name: thm:curvature_does_not_save
bounds.description: Bounded-curvature relaxation: with K-Lipschitz gradient, the min-norm under the curvature-tightened linear QP must still exceed delta_lin - (K/2)*delta_lin^2/tau. Tests the Taylor-remainder claim.
